messages:
maya: Heads-up — Q3 marketing push will drive a sustained multiregion spike. Need quota increases + short-term committed spend to seed dedicated warm pools (2–3 week runway). Can infra open requests for AWS & GCP across us-west-2, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1?

raj: OK — can you post target numbers per region/AZ and the account IDs? I can file AWS Service Quotas and GCP quota requests once we have exacts.

maya: Quick targets (conservative headroom):
- us-west-2: 40 A100s, 120 A10Gs, ENI limit +80, EIP +120, subnet IPs +1000
- eu-west-1: 24 A100s, 60 A10Gs, ENI +50, EIP +60, subnet IPs +600
- ap-southeast-1: 16 A10Gs, 40 A100s (mixed), ENI +40, EIP +40, subnet IPs +400
Accounts: aws: 123456789012 (prod-dedicated), gcp: redwood-prod-001
Also request increase to per-region VPC NAT gateway concurrent connections (we've hit cold NAT limits before).

olivia: For warm pool config, are we prewarmed with images that include model weights pull? We should avoid large cold-start downloads during burst.

maya: Yes — warm pool nodes will mount EBS with cached weights and use our local cache snapshot. Plan: 15% of target as warmed VMs per AZ + 10% extra as instant-burst transient. That gives ~25% effective headroom.

raj: Filing AWS requests — sample CLI I’ll run: 

```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --desired-value 300 --region us-west-2 --aws-account-id 123456789012
```

and for ENIs/EIPs we’ll open support cases where quota codes are different. GCP request template:

```
gcloud compute regions set-quota redwood-prod-001 --region=us-west2 --metric=CPUS --limit=600
```

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-8237 for AWS quota requests (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-8237). Assigned: raj.

leo_ops: Note: ap-southeast AZ zoning is tight. Recommend we request cross-AZ headroom and plan fallback to a nearby region if capacity denied. Also request permission for additional dedicated subnets in the account.

maya: Good catch. Add an ask to allow cross-region capacity spill (routing policy) + temporary peering for model sync.

sam_finance: Need cost estimate for committed spend ask — how long and how much? Also whether the team expects credits vs reserved commit.

maya: Proposal: 3-week committed buffer purchase (~50% of peak target) to get spot block pricing or short reserved discount. Back-of-envelope: us-west-2: $95k/mo if fully reserved at current list; short commit (3 weeks prorated) ~ $20–30k. eu: $12k/mo equivalent, apac: $8k/mo. Total ~ $10–15k for a 3-week buffer after prorate and partner discounts.

sam_finance: ok please attach exact SKU list and we'll see whether to use credits or a short-term committed purchase.

raj: Filing the rest now. I’ll tag the AWS & GCP support cases with the account owners and add the warm-pool justification.

maya: Thanks — tag me for approvals. If quotas come back delayed >48h we switch some traffic to shared-hosted fallback with throttled rate limits.

olivia: Also adding a quick smoke test plan for after quota changes: validation script to spin 5 nodes per AZ and run model handshake + KV cache warm. I’ll paste the script in the ticket.

infra-bot: INFRA-8237 updated: "service quotas requested" — ETA: 3 business days for review.

leo_ops: Please ensure tickets include subnet sizing (IP utilization growth curve) — last time we under-requested IPs and hit ENI bind failures.

maya: Will add the utilization graphs and a 4-week forecast to the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
